description:
Spend four unforgettable days immersed in the wild beauty of Song Kul Lake - the perfect amount of time to truly experience its magic rather than simply pass through.

Ride on horseback across sweeping alpine pastures and along the shores of the lake, stay in traditional yurts and welcoming shepherd homes, and disconnect from the noise of everyday life. With no rush and no crowds, you’ll experience authentic nomadic culture, wide-open landscapes, and the rare kind of solitude that makes this journey unforgettable.



Day 1: Arrival & Transfer to Kuiruchuk → Shilbily Pasture

08:00 AM: Arrive in Bishkek, meet your guide

Before Noon: Drive to Kuiruchuk (5–7 hours)

After Noon: Horseback trek to Shilbily Pasture (~5 hours)

Evening: Dinner and overnight at a local guest house



Day 2: Shilbily → Song Kul Lake

09:00-10:00 AM: Breakfast

10:30 AM: Horseback trek to Song Kul Lake (~5 hours)

Evening: Traditional dinner and overnight with local shepherds



Day 3: Song Kul Day Ride

08:30 AM: Breakfast

09:30 AM: Horseback trek across Song Kul Lake (~5 hours)

Afternoon: Arrive at a new yurt camp, continue to enjoy local nomadic life

Evening: Yurt stay and traditional dinner



Day 4: Song Kul → Kyzart/Bishkek

Morning: Breakfast and free time by the lake

Late Morning: Horseback return to Kyzart village (~6 hours)

Afternoon: Arrive in Kyzart and drive to Bishkek

Evening: Conclusion of a great trip
exclusions: Any accommodation in Bishkek
Helmets are not customary in Kyrgyzstan. There is a helmet rental ($5 USD per day per person, if desired)
Extra water, snacks, toiletries (pit stops available on request). These will all be carried in the saddlebags
Pickup or drop-off at the airport (+$20 each way)
Tips for the guide

description:
Want to explore more? This adventure lets you ride through the sweeping alpine pastures of Song-Kul Lake, while also taking you to Issyk Kul to witness the ancient art of eagle hunting. This four-day journey blends Kyrgyzstan's most iconic experiences - from horseback treks across high-altitude meadows to the otherworldly landscapes of Skazka Canyon. A perfect introduction to the best of nomadic culture and natural beauty.

\n\nDay 1: Bishkek → Kyzart/Kuiruchuk → Shilbily Pasture
\n7:00AM - 8:00 AM: Depart from your hostel in Bishkek, and meet your guide. 
\nMorning: Begin drive to Kuiruchuk (~4-5 hours)
\nNoon: Lunch near Kuiruchuk
\nAfternoon: Horseback trek to Shilbily Pasture (~5 hours)
\n Later evening: Arrival at yurt stays, dinner, and rest

\n\nDay 2: Shilbily → Song-Kul Lake
\n8:00 AM: Traditional Breakfast
\n9:00 AM: Horseback trek to Song-Kul Lake (~5 hours)
\nOn arrival: Traditional Lunch on arrival at the lake
\nAfternoon: Free time to explore the lake and surroundings
\nEvening: Overnight in yurts with a traditional dinner

\n\nDay 3: Song-Kul → Kyzart → Bokonbaevo / Issyk-Kul
\nMorning at Song-Kul with breakfast
\nHorseback return to Kyzart (~6 hours)
\nLunch on arrival to Kyzart
\nAfternoon: Transfer by car to Issyk-Kul / Bokonbaevo
\nEvening: Guesthouse stay, dinner and rest

\n\nDay 4: Bokonbaevo → Skazka Canyon → Bishkek
\nMorning: Breakfast + Eagle Hunting Show in Bokonbaevo
\nNoon: Lunch + visit to Skazka Canyon
\nLate Afternoon: Drive to Bishkek

description:
5 days to see all of Song-Kul, Kel-Suu, *and* Skazka Canyon doesn't exactly make for an enjoyable trip... so why not extend by one more day? With this tour, you’ll be able to ride through the epic Song-Kul Lake, experience nomadic life in yurts and shepherd houses, visit the great Kel Suu Lake, and Skazka Canyon.

\n\nDay 1: Bishkek → Kuiruchuk → Shilbily Pasture
\n07:00 - 08:00 AM: Arrive in Bishkek, meet your guide
\nBegin drive to Kuiruchuk (approx. 4–5 hours)
\nNoon: Lunch near Kuiruchuk
\nAfternoon: Horseback trek to Shilbily Pasture (~5 hours)
\nEvening: Dinner and rest at local yurts

\n\nDay 2: Shilbily → Song-Kul Lake
\nMorning: Traditional Breakfast
\nAfter Breakfast: Horseback trek to Song-Kul Lake (~5 hours)
\nAfternoon: Traditional Lunch on arrival at the lake
\nAfternoon: Free time to explore the lake and surroundings
\nEvening: Overnight in yurts with a traditional dinner

Day 3: Song-Kul → Naryn
\nMorning: Breakfast and free time by the lake
\nLate Morning: Horseback return to Kyzart (~6 hours)
\nAfternoon: Begin drive to Naryn
\n: Evening: Arrival in Naryn or similar region, dinner and rest at a local guest house

Day 4: Naryn → Kel-Suu
\nMorning: Depart Naryn after breakfast (Drive Time: Approx. 6 hours with scenic stops en route)
\nAfternoon: Lunch upon arrival at Kel-Suu base camp, followed by a hike to Kel-Suu Lake (can be saved for the morning after if you wish)
\nDinner & Overnight: Stay near Kel-Suu (yurt or camp depending on availability)

\n\nDay 5: Kel-Suu → Bokonbaevo (Issyk Kul)
\nMorning: Breakfast and hike to Kel Suu Lake if not done the day before
\nNoon: Return to Kel Suu Yurts from hike, begin drive to Bokonbaevo
\nEvening: Dinner and overnight at a guesthouse or optional hotel

\n\nDay 6: Bokonbaevo → Skazka Canyon → Bishkek
\nMorning: Breakfast and eagle hunting demonstration
\nAfternoon: Afternoon: Visit Skazka Canyon, spend 2~ hours exploring area (or spend more time if needed)
\nLate afternoon: late lunch, then drive back to Bishkek
\nEvening: Arrival back to Bishkek

description:
Discover Kyrgyzstan on a 9-day journey combining horseback treks, cultural experiences, and breathtaking landscapes. Ride across high mountain pastures to Song-Kul Lake, experience nomadic life in yurts and shepherd houses, visit the great Kel Suu lake and Skazka Canyon, and soak in Altyn Arashan’s hot springs.

\n\nDay 1: Arrival & Transfer to Kyzart / Kuiruchuk Street
\n08:00 AM: Arrive in Bishkek, meet your guide
\nBefore Noon: Begin drive to Kyzart / Kuiruchuk St. Area (5–7 hours)
\nAfternoon: Visit to Burana Tower, continue to Kyzart
\nAfternoon: Lunch stop
\nLate Afternoon: Arrival at local guesthouse
\nEvening: Dinner and overnight at a local guesthouse

\n\nDay 2: Kuiruchuk St. → Shilbily Pasture
\n08:00-9:00 AM: Breakfast
\n~9:00 AM: Begin horseback trek to Shilbily Pasture (~5 hours)
\n4:00-5:00 PM: Arrive at Shilbily Pasture, have lunch
\n5:00 PM onwards: Free time to explore and take in the peaceful scenery
\nEvening: Traditional dinner and overnight with local shepherds

\n\nDay 3: Shilbily → Song Kul Lake
\n08:30 AM: Breakfast
\n09:30 AM: Horseback trek to Song Kul Lake (~5 hours)
\nAfternoon: Explore the lake and surroundings
\nEvening: Yurt stay and traditional dinner

\n\nDay 4: Song Kul → Kyzart/Naryn
\nMorning: Breakfast and free time by the lake
\nLate Morning: Horseback return to Kyzart (~6 hours)
\nAfternoon: Arrive in Kyzart and drive to Naryn
\nEvening: Dinner and overnight at guest house

\n\nDay 5: Naryn → Kel Suu
\nMorning: Breakfast and departure to Kel Suu
\nAfternoon: Arrival at Kel Suu camps by lunch
\nAfternoon: Time to explore Kel Suu area
\nOvernight: Yurt stay near Kel Suu

\n\nDay 6: Kel Suu → Bokonbaevo (Issyk Kul)
\nMorning: Breakfast and hike to Kel Suu Lake (see optional extras at the lake)
\nNoon: Return to Kel Suu Yurts from the hike
\nAfternoon: Begin drive to Bokonbaevo
\nEvening: Dinner and overnight at a hostel or hotel

\n\nDay 7: Bokonbaevo → Skazka Canyon → Karakol
\nMorning: Breakfast
\nNoon: View an eagle hunting demonstration
\nAfternoon: Visit Skazka Canyon, Barskoon Waterfall, and Jeti-Ögüz Valley
\nAfternoon: Continue drive to Karakol
\nEvening: Dinner and overnight in Karakol

\n\nDay 8: Karakol → Altyn Arashan → Cholpon Ata
\nEarly Morning: Breakfast
\nBefore Noon: Trip to Altyn Arashan hot springs and return to Cholpon Ata
\nEvening: Dinner and overnight in Cholpon Ata

\n\nDay 9: Cholpon Ata → Bishkek
\nMorning: Breakfast
\nMorning: Swim and lunch (or visit to Grigorievka Gorge if too cold)
\nNoon: Lunch
\nNoon: Begin long drive back to Bishkek

\n\nNo riding experience needed – our guides accompany you every step of the way.

description:
Explore Kyrgyzstan on horseback as you ride across mountain valleys of Song Kul and then head east to the stunning vistas of Karakol and Altyn Arashan. This is a full 6-Day, 5-Night Horse Trek & Lake Adventure, including the return to Bishkek.

\n\nDay 1: Bishkek → Kuiruchuk → Shilbily Pasture
\n7:00AM - 8:00 AM: Depart from your hostel in Bishkek, and meet your guide. 
\nMorning: Begin drive to Kuiruchuk (~4-5 hours)
\nNoon: Lunch near Kuiruchuk
\nAfternoon: Horseback trek to Shilbily Pasture (~5 hours)
\n Later evening: Arrival at yurt stays, dinner, and rest

\n\nDay 2: Shilbily → Song-Kul Lake
\n8:00 AM: Traditional Breakfast
\nAfter breakfast: Horseback trek to Song-Kul Lake (~5 hours)
\nOn arrival: Traditional Lunch on arrival at the lake
\nAfternoon: Free time to explore the lake and surroundings
\nEvening: Overnight in yurts with a traditional dinner

\n\nDay 3: Song-Kul → Kyzart → Bokonbaevo
\n08:00AM: Morning at Song-Kul with breakfast
\nBegin horseback to Kyzart (~6 hours)
\nLunch on arrival to Kyzart
\nAfternoon: Drive to Bokonbaevo

\n\nDay 4: Bokonbaevo → Skazka Canyon → Karakol
\nMorning: Breakfast + Eagle Hunting Show in Bokonbaevo
\nNoon: Lunch + visit to Skazka Canyon
\nAfternoon: Begin drive to Karakol
\nEvening: Arrival in Karakol
\nDinner and rest in local guesthouse

\n\nDay 5: Karakol → Altyn Arashan
\nMorning: Breakfast in Karakol
\nMorning: Begin hike to Altyn Arashan (optional horse ride or car. See Exclusions.)
\nNoon: Arrive to Altyn Arashan
\nNoon: Lunch
\nAfternoon: Visit hot springs, free time
\nEvening: Dinner and rest in local guesthouse

\n\nDay 6: Altyn Arashan → Bishkek
\nMorning: Breakfast
\nBefore noon: Begin drive to Bishkek
\nEvening: Arrival in Bishkek

Starting from the foothills near Kochkor, this tour takes you along ancient nomadic trails, over high mountain passes, and through sweeping green valleys dotted with wildflowers and grazing animals.

\n\nDay 1: Bishkek → Kuiruchuk → Shilbily Pasture

\nAfternoon: Horseback trek to Shilbily Pasture (~5 hours)
\n Later evening: Arrival at yurt stays, dinner, and rest

\n\nDay 2: Shilbily → Song-Kul Lake
\n8:00 AM: Traditional Breakfast
\nAfter breakfast: Horseback trek to Song-Kul Lake (~5 hours)
\nOn arrival: Traditional Lunch on arrival at the lake
\nAfternoon: Free time to explore the lake and surroundings
\nEvening: Overnight in yurts with a traditional dinner

\n\nDay 3: Song-Kul → Kyzart → Bishkek
\n08:00AM: Morning at Song-Kul with breakfast

\nLunch on arrival to Kyzart
\nAfternoon: Drive back to Bishkek
